items.quote: High purity Cd rods (5N, Koch-Light Laboratories LTD., Colnbrook, England) and Pr pieces (99.9%, Smart Elements, Vienna, Austria) were used for sample preparation. To lower diffusion paths and increase the reaction rate during the calorimetric synthesis, samples were prepared with Cd and Pr powders. The metals were filed inside a glove box under Ar atmosphere (oxygen level: o1 ppm, water level: o1 ppm) to prevent oxidation. The metal powders were then weighed according to calculated amounts, mixed homogeneously and pressed into compact pellets.
